gloss_en: hands (yadayim/yadin) — the paired bodily limbs, right and left hand, used as a mystical aspect (bechina) in Likutey Moharan: symbolizing wisdom/holiness, the revealed Torah, receiving (kabbalah), clapping in prayer, north-south, and heaven (fire and water); not the verb 'to judge' (yadin from din) nor any other homograph
